margot.note: The Associated Press reported on 2024-11-01 that the Twins declined Margot's 2025 option and that, because it was declined, Los Angeles will pay Minnesota an additional $2 million on Dec. 1, 2026. The event has one CASH asset and no Future Considerations placeholder, and the schema permits several CASH components with distinct names, so the guaranteed amount fills the existing asset and a distinct CASH asset carries the additional amount. The role note says it is owed, payable 2026-12-01; it does not claim it has been paid. Not stored as $8,000,000.

frias.after: HELD: the named Cleveland announcement could not be read
frias.note: The official Cleveland press release answered HTTP 403 and has no archive snapshot, so it was never read and cannot be registered as a source. A CASH_SETTLEMENT resolution needs a real source and cannot take an unread one. The existing record reads Player To Be Named Later while the brief describes cash considerations, which the unreadable page would have had to reconcile. No write; the structure (CASH_SETTLEMENT, amount NULL, date 2017-01-30) is ready the moment a readable copy of the announcement exists.

garland.note: The MLB.com transaction list gives both ends of the 2011 Dodgers control interval. The 2011 exit closes the interval the signing opens and does not touch the 2009 interval. His contract is not recorded.
